name: Talkward – Live Chat, AI Chatbot & Helpdesk
author: talkward

sections.description:
Talkward puts a live chat on your WordPress site and collects every customer message in one shared inbox: live chat, email, WhatsApp, Instagram and Facebook. An AI agent can answer around the clock and hands tricky cases to your team.

This plugin connects your site to Talkward. You need a Talkward account; the free plan is enough for the live chat and you can create it right from the plugin.

What you get on the free plan

  • Live chat on your site in two minutes – one switch, no code. Colours and greeting are set in Talkward.
  • One inbox for chat and email – answer from the browser or the phone app.
  • One seat, up to 50 active contacts – enough to start, free for as long as you like.

What paid plans add

  • More channels – WhatsApp, Instagram and Facebook in the same inbox (from Basic).
  • Live visitors – see who is on your site right now, as a list or on a world map (from Basic).
  • AI agent – answers in the customer’s language, learns from your website, hands over with a summary (from Professional).
  • WooCommerce orders in the conversation – status, payment and tracking next to every chat, for your team and the AI agent (from Professional).

Made for WooCommerce stores

  • The AI answers “Where is my order?” – after checking order number and email or postcode.
  • Customer file next to every conversation – all orders of a customer, guest orders included.
  • Works behind any firewall – your store sends orders to Talkward. Talkward never calls into your store, so Cloudflare, Sucuri or your host’s bot protection stay exactly as they are.
  • Live – new and changed orders reach Talkward within seconds, in the background (Action Scheduler).
  • HPOS and block checkout are supported.

WooCommerce is optional. Without it, the plugin shows the chat and nothing else.

Hosted in Europe

Talkward runs on servers in Germany.

External services

This plugin connects to the Talkward service (https://talkward.app), operated by Talkward. It cannot work without it: Talkward hosts the inbox, the chat window and the AI agent.

Before you connect, nothing is sent. The buttons “Create free account” and “I already have an account” open Talkward in your browser and pass the address and name of your site, so Talkward can show which site wants to connect.

After you connect:

  • Once an hour the plugin sends a status to Talkward: the plugin version, your WordPress and WooCommerce versions, whether the chat is switched on, and the progress of the order sync. This keeps the connection alive and tells you in Talkward when an update is due.
  • While the chat is switched on, every page of your site loads the chat script from Talkward (https://chat.talkward.app/widget.js). When a visitor opens the chat, what they write is sent to Talkward, together with technical data their browser transmits (such as the IP address and the page they are on).
  • If WooCommerce is active and your Talkward plan includes order data (from Professional), the plugin sends your orders of the last 90 days and every new or changed order: order data including customer name, email, addresses and items. On plans without order data the plugin sends no orders. Talkward keeps orders for at most 12 months and deletes them when you disconnect.

Disconnecting in the plugin or in Talkward stops all of this.

  • Terms: https://talkward.app/en/terms/
  • Privacy: https://talkward.app/en/privacy/
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Open “Talkward” in the WordPress menu.
  3. Click “Create free account” (or “I already have an account”), confirm the connection in Talkward, and you are back.
  4. The chat is live. Adjust its look and greeting in Talkward.
sections.faq:
Is it really free?

Yes. The free Talkward plan includes live chat and email for one seat and up to 50 active contacts, with no time limit. New accounts can try everything in the Professional plan for 30 days; after that the account continues on the free plan unless you pick a paid one.

Do I need WooCommerce?

No. The live chat works on any WordPress site. With WooCommerce and the Professional plan, your orders appear next to every conversation.

Do I need to change my Cloudflare or firewall settings?

No. All connections go from your site to Talkward.

Can I switch the chat off again?

Yes, with the switch on the Talkward page in WordPress. Disconnecting switches it off as well.

Which tracking plugins are supported?

Shipment Tracking, Advanced Shipment Tracking and Germanized tracking numbers show up in Talkward automatically.

Where is my data stored?

On servers in Germany. See the section “External services” for what is sent and when.
sections.changelog:
1.2.0

  • Works on every WordPress site, WooCommerce is no longer required.
  • The live chat is the main feature: it is switched on as soon as you connect, with a switch to turn it off.
  • Create a free Talkward account right from the plugin.
  • Talkward has its own entry in the WordPress menu.
  • Orders are only sent when your Talkward plan includes order data.

1.1.0

  • The Talkward page shows when a new version is out, with what’s new and a one-click update.
  • Automatic updates can be switched on right on the Talkward page.
  • “View details” now shows the changelog.

1.0.0

  • First release: one-click connect, live order sync, chat widget, automatic updates.
